en-US.description: Upload shoe product images and an optional model image to generate footwear try-on visuals.
en-US.empty.products: Upload at least 1 shoe image first
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.referenceLimit: The reference image limit for the current model has been reached
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.generationMode.advanced.desc: Best for high-resolution full-body or close-up images with dense textures, complex materials, and difficult poses.
en-US.generationMode.fast.desc: Best for full-body images below 2K or close-up images below 1K with simple poses.
en-US.generationMode.pro.desc: Prioritizes the best silhouette and material fidelity.
en-US.generationMode.standard.desc: Best for full-body images above 2K or close-up images above 1K.
en-US.label: Boots Try-On
en-US.upload.model: Upload a model image with visible feet and legs
en-US.upload.productTip: Supports sneakers, boots, heels, flats, and sandals. Upload 1-2 reference images for better shoe matching.

zh-CN.description: 上传鞋履商品图和可选模特图，一键生成鞋履试穿效果图。
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.referenceLimit: 参考图数量已达当前模型上限
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.generationMode.advanced.desc: 适合分辨率高于 2K 的全身图或高于 1K 的局部图，且包含细密纹理复杂材质与复杂的姿势。
zh-CN.generationMode.fast.desc: 适合分辨率低于 2K 的全身图或低于 1K 的局部图，简单姿势。
zh-CN.generationMode.pro.desc: 版型、材质还原效果更好。
zh-CN.generationMode.standard.desc: 适合分辨率高于 2K 的全身图或高于 1K 的局部图。
zh-CN.label: 鞋靴试穿
zh-CN.upload.model: 点击上传带脚部/小腿的模特图
zh-CN.upload.productTip: 支持运动鞋、靴子、高跟鞋、平底鞋、凉鞋等，建议上传 1-2 张鞋履参考图。
